hero.title: Plan a week of home cooking in seconds.
hero.subtitle: Chop turns {count} Cameroonian and family favourites into a weekly plan, a costed shopping list and step-by-step recipes. Breakfast to supper, right on your phone.

features.title: Everything you need to stop asking “what’s for dinner?”
features.subtitle: Plan, shop and cook with one app built around the food you actually eat.

planner.title: Weekly planner
planner.text: Breakfast, lunch and supper for every day, following each day’s theme. Keep what you like and reroll the rest.

batch.title: Cook ahead
batch.text: Only free twice a week? Cook one dish that keeps well and eat it until the next cooking day, with sides and light suppers planned.

events.title: Event menus
events.text: Birthdays, weddings, holidays: a full menu for your guest count, with an estimated cost per guest.

shopping.title: Costed shopping list
shopping.text: Turn any plan into a list with prices in FCFA. Tick items off at the market and share it in one tap.

markets.title: Markets near you
markets.text: Find markets, butchers, fishmongers and grocery stores around you, with directions.

cookbook.title: Step-by-step recipes
cookbook.text: Follow each recipe one stop at a time, and keep your own recipes and photos in your kitchen.

how.title: From “I don’t know” to dinner in three steps

1.title: Pick your days
1.text: Tell Chop which days you can cook and how many people are eating.

2.title: Get your plan
2.text: Every meal is planned, with sides that go together and leftovers counted.

3.title: Shop and cook
3.text: Take the costed list to the market, then follow each recipe step by step.

batch.title: Cook once. Eat well for three days.
batch.text: Busy week? Choose the days you’re free and Chop plans one big dish for each, then places the leftovers on the right days.
batch.b1: One dish per cooking day, with a side that goes with it
batch.b2: Leftovers placed until your next cooking day
batch.b3: A snack day in the middle when you need a break

events.title: Plan the party. Know the cost.
events.text: Pick the occasion, the number of guests and your budget. Chop proposes the menu, scales the quantities and estimates what you’ll spend.
events.b1: Seven occasions, from birthdays to family lunches
events.b2: Quantities scaled to your guest count
events.b3: Change any price and Chop remembers it

days.title: A theme for every day of the week
days.subtitle: Your family’s food list, organised so deciding is easy.

cta.title: Ready to plan your week?
cta.text: Free, with no account needed. Install Chop on your phone and it works offline.
